scientific_integrity: Integral local regularity and Néron component arithmetic proved for the fixed elementary-symmetric model; geometric special fibre is previously published; historical priority uncertain.
scientific_limitations: Not a theorem about an arbitrary integral model or other primes.
The published five-node fibre and its zeta function are antecedents, not claimed new.
Unindexed historical computations may be stronger.
title: Integral semistability and the nonsplit Néron component group of Bring’s curve at two
